limitations: Exploratory selection on an exposed development panel; no confirmed fidelity winner or source/human-population claim.
Replicate0 outcomes reused unchanged; no best-replicate selection. Fresh provider request events do not prove statisticalIID sampling.
Repeated controls are references to the original actual rows, not new control observations or calls. Order reversals/replicates do not add source groups.
Unpromoted one-replicate grid and richer source-only intervention are not pooled here.
No-profile/name-only26/28 and raw2048 28/28 reveal limited discrimination for personal-profile benefit.
P7 has additional approved peer evidence; all others preserve target-only sparse inputs.

Aggregate counts, ranking, all-three cost, private reports and target labels are unchanged. Add independently matched driver terminal index.
